Subject: Follow-up and next steps from today's discovery

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for your time today. Really helpful to walk through Acme's current inference bottlenecks and priorities. Quick recap so we're aligned:

- Primary goal: reduce RLHF model inference latency for triage pipeline to under 200ms p95 while lowering per-token cost.
- Constraints: PHI-sensitive data, VPC-only deployment for production, and an on-prem GPU footprint for pre-prod.
- Key stakeholders: Product (you), ML (Samira), Infra (you mentioned an infra lead), and Security (legal/compliance later).

Next step from our side: schedule a 60-90 minute technical deep dive where our Solutions Engineer and infra partner can meet Samira and your infra lead to:

Agenda (suggested, flexible):
1) 10-15m: introductions + architecture goals
2) 25-35m: ML deep dive - model variants, sequence lengths, KV cache patterns, quantization tolerance
3) 20-30m: infra & deployment - network topology, VPC/KMS, dedicated vs private deployment options, runbook requirements
4) 10m: open questions + proposed mutual action plan

Can you share 2-3 windows next week that work for Samira + infra? We're aware your timezone is PDT. For planning, we have these blocks open on our side:
- Tue 6/22: 9:00-11:30am PT
- Wed 6/23: 1:30-4:00pm PT
- Thu 6/24: 8:30-11:00am PT

I'll loop in our SE (Marissa) and infra lead (Camila) once you confirm a slot. I'll also attach a short mutual action plan and a proposed SE agenda so you can share with your team.

Thanks - looking forward to the next conversation.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
